title: Billet Designator-Enlisted (MGySgt to Pvt) FMOS*, DC CD&I
raw_text:
6.     MOS 8014, Billet Designator-Enlisted (MGySgt to Pvt) FMOS*, DC CD&I

    a. Summary. This MOS will be used in T/O's to designate a billet to
which any enlisted Marine may be assigned but will not be assigned to an
individual.

       b.   Prerequisites.    None.

       c.   Requirements.    None.

       d.   Duties.   As assigned.




                                         3-461                         Enclosure (1)
 3149                                                               NAVMC 1200.1L



    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
Enlisted Military Training/Reporting/Special Duty Code (no related SOC) 00-
0001.

       f.   Related Military Skill.   None.
